title:
Know every
plant you *grow*
body: Point your camera at any plant and get an answer in seconds.
shot: The result screen straight after a scan: the photo, the plant's name and the confidence bar.

title:
Honest about
how *sure* it is
body: Every answer shows its confidence, with the other possibilities when it's close.
shot: A plant's page scrolled to the Identification card, ideally one listing other possibilities.

title:
Care that follows
the *seasons*
body: Watering advice for the time of year where you live.
shot: A plant's Care section: the 'Watering now' card and the light, water, temperature and humidity tiles.

title:
Know what's *safe*
for your pets
body: Clear warnings for cats, dogs and children.
shot: The 'Pets and children' section for a toxic plant — a monstera, peace lily or lily works well.

title:
Fix problems
*before* they spread
body: What's going wrong, why, and exactly what to do.
shot: The 'If something looks wrong' section on a plant's page.

title:
Your whole
*collection*
body: Photos, notes and a watering log for every plant.
shot: Home with four or more saved plants that have good photos.

title:
Look up *any*
plant
body: Care guides for 136 plants. No scan needed.
shot: Home → Look up a plant: the list, or a care guide opened from it.

title:
Water at the
*right* time
body: Reminders based on your own watering log, not a generic schedule.
shot: A plant's watering log with a few entries and the guidance section showing.

title:
Beautiful in
light or *dark*
body: Follows your iPhone, or pick your look.

title:
No traps
*Cancel* any time
body: See the price before any trial. No account needed.
shot: Onboarding: the 'Built on three promises' screen.
